notes: σκανδάλων → occasions of stumbling heads on occasions because the same verse renders the same lexeme by a bare occasions twice (rules 24, 66); heading on stumbling remains defensible.
τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ → to that man aligns the article to the supplied demonstrative with its case preposition (rules 21, 60), no Greek demonstrative competing for the slot.
Units SBLGNT.MAT.18.7.v005 and v006 remain underdetermined; both readings are translated.
